Seasonal message for visitors
It is easier with this note
Travelers should prepare pet travel papers, carrier details, and comfort items before reaching the airport.

Aurelia Skyways
Companion Animal Travel Desk

The Companion Animal Travel Desk reminds travelers that animal acceptance depends on careful review of each case. Our trained staff handle every journey with steady care, and a welfare coordinator checks comfort needs so the trip can be managed with respect. Please keep your pet calm, secure, and ready for inspection, and bring any required papers in clean condition.

For bird travel, <<FACT F065>>. Please place the animal in an approved container and follow staff guidance at every stage. For cat travel, <<FACT F079>>. If your plans change, tell the desk at once so we can update the travel file and reduce stress for the animal.

We appreciate your cooperation and your care for the welfare of your companion. For help with planning, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
